raw.rationale: Iobenguane is a norepinephrine analog taken up by the norepinephrine transporter (NET/SLC6A2), so at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is expected to be cytotoxic only to NET-expressing tumors, chiefly neuroblastoma and pheochromocytoma, neither of which is among the listed lineages; the listed lineages lack this uptake mechanism and published PRISM data show no lineage-selective killing. Thus all probabilities are very low and near the base rate.
